content: {"items":[{"statement":"The toponyms Kourniachto, Kleftolimano, Fygou, Fylakio, Vardia, Tourkolimnionas, Pano and Kato Maneta are probably the living remnants of pirate activity in the past.","evidence_id":"e-a651d645c92ef0849332","passage_ids":[9],"kind":"source_statement","source_type":"SECONDARY_SOURCE","actors":[],"places":[],"dates":[],"usage_type":"OTHER","uncertainty":["TOPONYM_AND_USAGE_REQUIRE_SEMANTIC_EXTRACTION"]},{"statement":"The bays Pano and Kato Maneta likely derived their names from the Zakynthian corsair Eustathios (Stathis) Romanos or Manetas, who operated as a pirate in the Aegean Sea between 1678 and 1684.","evidence_id":"e-a651d645c92ef0849332","passage_ids":[12],"kind":"source_statement","source_type":"SECONDARY_SOURCE","actors":["Eustathios (Stathis) Romanos or Manetas"],"places":[],"dates":["1678-1684"],"usage_type":"RAID_LOCATION","uncertainty":["TOPONYM_AND_USAGE_REQUIRE_SEMANTIC_EXTRACTION","ORIGINAL_NOT_INSPECTED","SOURCE_GENEALOGY_PENDING","INDEPENDENCE_UNRESOLVED"]}]}
